project.title: Ride Slowly, Ride Safely
project.logline: Two young brothers learn that safe cycling matters more than winning a race.

story.idea: Alex and Bob are young brothers cycling in a park. Bob races toward a branch and has a mild fall. Alex comforts him, and Bob learns to ride slowly and safely.
story.theme: Safety is more important than speed.
story.moral: Ride slowly, watch the path, and help each other.
